description: Only the 'Common across DC' cases need a human: https://hello.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DCCore/pages/7424609152/Human+review+required+-+Enable+semi-automated+FE+Renovate+upgrades. Renovate's automerge would not stop the automerger, it only honours the commit marker.

packageRules.description: Most bumps need no human, so they merge and notify nobody.
Public API and platform versioned, so a major bump needs coordination across DC.
Public API and platform versioned, and not reliably SemVer, so minor bumps need coordination too.
0.x has no SemVer promise, so minor upgrades can break.
Upgrading gains nothing: Atlassian owned, no security issues, no transitive deps.
